title: Paper Towels 6-roll

drivers.name: Promotion: 30% off
drivers.evidence: Past 30% off (2026-03-02) gave x2.18 lift; average promotion lift is x2.09; 17 past occurrences support this.

adjustment.analysis: The 30% off promotion is the primary driver. Past 30% off events (2026-03-02) show a noise-adjusted lift of x2.18, consistent with the product's average promotion lift of x2.09. The classical model's uplift of +109% (x2.09) is well-supported. The prior week (Memorial Day) shows a noise-adjusted drop of x0.89, but this is already accounted for in the event history. No evidence of pantry loading beyond the immediate post-promo dip (x0.78), and the current week is not immediately after a promotion. The baseline already reflects seasonal trends. The promotion is identical to a prior successful one, so confidence is high.

In the evidence below, 'vs baseline' = actual units / what this same baseline predicted for that week.
It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-21% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
